items.removalCriteria: Add an explicitly authorized, audited reconciliation/archive path for permanently uncertain feedback review or delivery records, preserving immutable receipts, actor/conversation binding and no automatic replay; verify capacity can be reclaimed without re-invoking model/tool effects or duplicating unknown Teams sends.

Replace the hosted encrypted-message upload/commit ordering with a transaction or equivalent lifecycle that guarantees loser cleanup, then deploy a provenance-safe orphan sweeper and verify that no unreferenced encrypted raw objects remain.

After a verified package-managed release is installed and is the retained rollback, remove the pinned alpha.797 source contract/constant/runbook branch and its tests; never use it for target creation.
